network_requirements_summary: Preferred connectivity: AWS PrivateLink endpoints into customer VPC for control-plane and data-plane where possible
Alternative: Cross-account VPC peering with explicit route tables and shared security group patterns
Firewall rules: only outbound TLS(443) from customer app subnets to Redwood ENIs; provide exact IP ranges or ENI behavior for PrivateLink
Egress controls: customer requires no fallback over public internet; document NAT / proxy recommendations and egressthrough options
IP allowlists: customer needs static IPs or small CIDR blocks for allowlisting on internal firewalls and perimeter appliances
Audit logging: request-level logs exported to customer SIEM (Splunk) via Kinesis/CloudWatch subscription or S3 export with SSE-KMS
KMS integration: BYOK via AWS KMS or HSM, envelope encryption for stored artifacts, clear notes on key rotation impacts on cached KV/metrics
Data residency: ability to pin inference and log storage to specific region (us-east-1 or eu-west-1) and to prevent cross-region fallthrough
